name: findtunes
description: Find songs from video links or lyrics, and get songs like any song, with FindTunes.

interface.longDescription: Paste a supported public video link and ask what song is playing, type lyrics you remember, or ask for songs like a song you love. FindTunes returns the song name, artist, available cover art, 30 second previews, Spotify or Apple Music links, and a result page when a song is identified. Lyrics matches are best guesses with other possible songs. No sign-in is required for this integration. Shared service limits apply. Private, restricted, deleted, or unclear videos may not return a song. FindTunes does not connect to your music account, record your device, or identify every song in every video.
capabilities: Find music from a public video link
Find a song from lyrics you remember
Read an existing FindTunes song result
defaultPrompt: What song is playing in this YouTube Short?
What song goes: kiki do you love me are you riding?
Give me songs like Espresso by Sabrina Carpenter.

publication.release_notes: Adds two read-only tools: find_song_by_lyrics (find a song from lyrics the user remembers) and songs_like (songs similar to a named song), each returning previews and listening links. Existing identify_song and get_song_result are unchanged.
